settings.privacyPolicy:
## Information you choose to share
You can contact Krishna Tracer through the phone, WhatsApp, and social links on this website. The website does not receive messages you send directly through those external services. If you choose to share personal details in an enquiry, those details are handled by the service you use and by the store when you contact us.

## Online orders
If you place an online order, the checkout asks for your name, mobile number, delivery address, PIN code, city and state, with email and landmark optional. The site records these details together with the items, amounts, and status of your order so the store can process and support the order.

To arrange a payment, the site sends the customer and order details needed for checkout to Cashfree and opens Cashfree's hosted payment page. Payment processing is handled by Cashfree. The site does not collect or store card details or UPI PINs. Cashfree's own privacy terms apply to information you provide to its service.

## External services and links
This website links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Maps, and Cashfree. Opening one of these services takes you to its own platform, which may collect information under its own privacy terms. The site may prefill a WhatsApp enquiry message, but it does not send the message for you.

## Cookies and browser storage
The admin area uses an authentication cookie to keep an administrator signed in. During checkout, the browser's session storage keeps identifiers needed to associate and safely retry a checkout attempt. The current website implementation does not include analytics or advertising tracking scripts.

## Questions about your information
To ask the store about information you have shared through an enquiry or order, use the contact details below. Please include enough information for the store to identify the relevant enquiry or order.
